posts.title: The Shortest IPv6 Addresses
posts.description: I was looking for the shortest possible IPv6 equivalent of 1.1.1.1 (and its secondary 1.0.0.1, sometimes abbreviate 1.1).

posts.title: The US lock of the Web
A valid HTML zip bomb
posts.description: Many sites have been affected by the aggressiveness of web crawlers designed to improve LLMs. I’ve been relatively spared, but since the phenomenon started, I've been looking for a solution to implement. Today, I present a zip bomb gzip and brotli that is valid HTML.
